already_done.text: Rate-limit middleware skeleton written and merged behind a feature flag.
Deploy-reset bug fixed and merged: counters moved to Redis, covered by a regression test.

assumptions.text: Redis is available in all environments.
Clients tolerate HTTP 429 responses with a Retry-After header.

constraints.text: No new external dependencies beyond what the service already uses.
Rate limiting may add at most 5 ms latency at p99.
Counters must survive deploys; a deploy must not reset client usage.

decisions.text: Use a fixed window counter algorithm.

decisions.rationale: Load test showed the fixed window allows 2x bursts at window boundaries; the token bucket prototype passed the same load test.
Counters must be consistent across 6 instances and survive deploys; in-memory counters reset on deploy and diverged per instance.
decisions.text: Store counters in Redis with a shared key per client.
Default limit 100 requests per minute per client.

decisions.rationale: Product review: a legitimate batch client was being throttled at 100 per minute.
decisions.text: Default limit 600 requests per minute per client.

evidence.text: Load test: fixed window allows 2x limit bursts at window boundaries; token bucket prototype passed without boundary bursts.
Product review set the default limit to 600 requests per minute after a legitimate batch client was throttled at 100.

evidence.source: test suite status (given in session materials)
evidence.text: test_burst_allowance fails intermittently, roughly one run in five; root cause not identified.

must_not_state.text: The current algorithm is the fixed window counter.

must_not_state.text: The current default limit is 100 requests per minute.
Counters should be stored in process memory (reverting the Redis fix).

next_actions.text: Merge the token bucket implementation from the prototype branch as the release algorithm.
Investigate the intermittent test_burst_allowance failure before release.

objective: Implement rate limiting for a multi-instance API gateway, surviving a mid-session algorithm and default-limit change.

open_questions.text: What is the root cause of the intermittent test_burst_allowance failure? Not yet identified.
